title: Suspicious Property Transaction Reports Filed and Cases Linked to Money Laundering
what_it_is: Suspicious Property Transaction Reports Filed and Cases Linked to Money Laundering

sections.label: Police money laundering conviction tracking
sections.summary: The Police do not track money laundering convictions by asset class.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police do not track money laundering convictions by asset class.

sections.label: Developer anti-money laundering reporting duties
sections.summary: URA issued an anti-money laundering guide to developers, and the Developers (Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing) Act 2018 takes effect on 28 June 2023, requiring suspicious transaction reports.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) has disseminated a guide on anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism requirements to developers when issuing a sale license to developers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And, as he has mentioned, the Developers (Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing) Act 2018 will be implemented on 28 June 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under section 12D of this Act, when a licensed housing developer knows or has reasonable grounds to suspect any matter mentioned in section 45(1) of the Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) or CDSA, a licensed housing developer must, in accordance with section 45 of the CDSA, disclose the matter to a Suspicious Transaction Reporting Officer by way of a suspicious transaction report.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When we look at the principles of reporting, as long as the developer is aware that in the course of the trade profession, business or employment, he knows or has reason to suspect that any property directly or indirectly represents proceeds of drug dealing or criminal conduct or was used or is intended to be used in connection with drug dealing or criminal conduct, that he is to lodge a suspicious transaction report.
